__inputs.name: DS_NGVM
__inputs.label: NGVM reporting database
__inputs.description: PostgreSQL data source of the reporting database

list.name: tenant
list.label: Client
list.query: SELECT tenant AS __value, tenant_name AS __text FROM ngvm.latest_runs ORDER BY tenant_name
list.definition: SELECT tenant AS __value, tenant_name AS __text FROM ngvm.latest_runs ORDER BY tenant_name

panels.title: Open with a priority
panels.description: Decisions of the latest run in a priority of the client's SLA.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM ngvm.decision_facts f WHERE f.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM ngvm.latest_runs WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND f.priority IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Past their SLA due date
panels.description: Decisions of the latest run past the due date of their priority.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM ngvm.decision_facts f WHERE f.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM ngvm.latest_runs WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND f.sla_status = 'overdue'

panels.title: SLA due within 7 days
panels.description: Decisions of the latest run whose SLA due date is within the next 7 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM ngvm.decision_facts f WHERE f.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM ngvm.latest_runs WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND f.sla_due BETWEEN f.day AND f.day + 7

panels.title: Fixed within the SLA
panels.description: Share of the findings with a priority fixed on or before their SLA due date (dashboard time range).

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN within_sla THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value FROM ngvm.finding_closures WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND $__timeFilter(closed_at) AND outcome = 'fixed' AND within_sla IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Same findings within BOD 26-04
panels.description: The same findings against their BOD 26-04 due date, for comparison.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN within_due THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value FROM ngvm.finding_closures WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND $__timeFilter(closed_at) AND outcome = 'fixed' AND within_sla IS NOT NULL AND within_due IS NOT NULL

panels.title: ACT and ATTEND in no priority
panels.description: Decisions to remediate that no rule of the client's SLA sorts: their BOD 26-04 due date applies.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM ngvm.decision_facts f WHERE f.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM ngvm.latest_runs WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND f.priority IS NULL AND f.level IN ('ACT', 'ATTEND') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ngvm.runs x WHERE x.run_id = f.run_id AND x.sla_overdue IS NOT NULL)

panels.title: By priority
panels.description: Per priority: open decisions of the latest run, past their SLA due date, due within 7 days; findings fixed in the time range, the share fixed on time and the mean days from the first observation.

targets.rawSql:
WITH o AS (SELECT f.priority, min(f.priority_rank) AS rk, count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.sla_status = 'overdue') AS late, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.sla_due BETWEEN f.day AND f.day + 7) AS soon FROM ngvm.decision_facts f WHERE f.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM ngvm.latest_runs WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND f.priority IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.priority),
c AS (SELECT priority, min(priority_rank) AS rk, count(*) AS n, round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN within_sla THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS pct, round(avg(days_open), 1) AS d FROM ngvm.finding_closures WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND $__timeFilter(closed_at) AND outcome = 'fixed' AND priority IS NOT NULL GROUP BY priority)
SELECT priority AS "Priority", coalesce(o.n, 0) AS "Open", coalesce(o.late, 0) AS "Overdue", coalesce(o.soon, 0) AS "Due within 7 days", coalesce(c.n, 0) AS "Fixed", c.pct AS "Fixed within the SLA (%)", c.d AS "Mean days"
FROM o FULL JOIN c USING (priority) ORDER BY coalesce(o.rk, c.rk), priority

panels.title: Past their SLA due date per day
panels.description: Each day's latest run: decisions past their SLA due date and due within 7 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT x.generated_at::date::timestamptz AS time, sum(x.sla_overdue) AS "Overdue", sum(x.sla_due_soon) AS "Due within 7 days" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (tenant, generated_at::date) run_id FROM ngvm.runs
  WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND $__timeFilter(generated_at)
  ORDER BY tenant, generated_at::date, generated_at DESC) r JOIN ngvm.runs x USING (run_id) WHERE x.sla_overdue IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Overdue decisions
panels.description: Decisions of the latest run past their SLA due date, the oldest due date first.

targets.rawSql: SELECT f.asset_name AS "Asset", f.cve AS "CVE", f.level AS "Level", f.priority AS "Priority", f.sla_due AS "SLA due", (f.day - f.sla_due) AS "Days late", f.sla_since AS "In priority since", f.due_date AS "BOD 26-04 due", f.kev_label AS "KEV", f.title AS "Description" FROM ngvm.decision_facts f WHERE f.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM ngvm.latest_runs WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND f.sla_status = 'overdue' ORDER BY f.sla_due, f.priority_rank, f.level_rank, f.cve LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Due within 7 days
panels.description: Decisions of the latest run whose SLA due date is within the next 7 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT f.asset_name AS "Asset", f.cve AS "CVE", f.level AS "Level", f.priority AS "Priority", f.sla_due AS "SLA due", f.due_date AS "BOD 26-04 due", f.kev_label AS "KEV", f.title AS "Description" FROM ngvm.decision_facts f WHERE f.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM ngvm.latest_runs WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND f.sla_due BETWEEN f.day AND f.day + 7 ORDER BY f.sla_due, f.priority_rank, f.level_rank, f.cve LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Fixes against the SLA, when they happened
panels.description: Findings fixed in the time range, against their deadline (SLA due date, else BOD 26-04), by when the fix happened: between the last scan that still saw the flaw and the first that did not. Met (observed): that scan is on time; missed: the flaw was still seen after the deadline; met (declared, verified): the date the team declared in the ITSM lies in that interval and on time (after it: missed); to verify: none of these.

targets.rawSql: SELECT fix_status AS "Status", count(*) AS "Findings" FROM ngvm.finding_closures WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND $__timeFilter(closed_at) AND outcome = 'fixed' AND fix_status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fix_status ORDER BY CASE fix_status WHEN 'met (observed)' THEN 1 WHEN 'met (declared, verified)' THEN 2 WHEN 'to verify' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

panels.title: Fixes missed or to verify
panels.description: The fixes of the time range that missed their deadline, or whose interval straddles it without a declared date to place them: the scans before and after, and the date declared in the ITSM.

targets.rawSql: SELECT asset_name AS "Asset", cve AS "CVE", priority AS "Priority", fix_status AS "Status", deadline AS "Deadline", last_vulnerable AS "Last seen vulnerable", first_clean AS "First clean scan", declared_at AS "Declared in the ITSM" FROM ngvm.finding_closures WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND $__timeFilter(closed_at) AND outcome = 'fixed' AND fix_status IN ('missed', 'to verify') ORDER BY deadline, asset_name, cve LIMIT 1000
